sourceRefs.locator: Decree of 7 March 1924, arts. 1 and 3. The former exhibition grounds and the intended opening on 1 September are explicit. The programme is to include a reception and celebrations for administrative staff and convalescent patients. These are instructions for the celebration.

Decree of 2 September 1924, Gaceta Oficial no. 4487, 13 September 1924, printed p. 393, left column, “Artículo único”, signed Porras and Jiménez. The text places in public service the hospital built by the nation on a Panama City site fronting Avenida Federico Boyd in the former Exposición Nacional area. PDF p. 2 is a facsimile.

Memoria del Hospital Santo Tomás 2020–2021, “Recordar es vivir”, caption and opening paragraph. The institution identifies the ceremony and the inauguration by President Belisario Porras on 1 September 1924.

Chapter VI, “Hospitales en la Época del Canal Francés”, pp. CXLIX–CLI. Companyo, his earlier work at Suez, Huerta de Gallo, the fundraising committee, the September thanksgiving Mass, transfers of patients, the sisters, Colón, the former Taboga hotel and the orphanage. Chapter VII, pp. CLXXIV–CLXXVI, reports the 1916 request for larger premises and lottery funding. Pp. CLXXXII–CLXXXIII name the four nursing graduates of 1912. For the 1924 opening date use the contemporary decrees, which supersede the December date printed on p. CLXXV.

Doctoral thesis, printed p. 50, citing Rodríguez on the 1904 appointment and 1908 count of 117 nurses among 205 US women employed in the Canal Zone. Note 49 quotes La Estrella de Panamá, 9 February 1905, vol. LVI, no. 13544, p. 10, on malaria admissions and the latrines at Ancón. Pp. 52–53 quote the same newspaper of 13 March 1909 on admission of single women aged sixteen to twenty-five at Santo Tomás.

Ficha P0410, Edificio Hospital Santo Tomás y sus jardines, Calidonia, Avenida Balboa between calles 34 and 37 Este. WGS84 / UTM 17N 661372.55 E, 991793.16 N, converted to 8.96942° N, 79.53211° W. Historical description gives separate buildings, sidewalks and gardens and identifies the broad eaves.
